expects.query: Deploy the VSS **search** profile on this two-GPU {{platform}} host using the `/vss-deploy-test-openshell` skill end-to-end and autonomously. Override the default local RT-VLM and use the configured remote VLM endpoint instead; keep the local `vss-rtvi-vlm` service as the OpenAI-compatible proxy. After the stack is healthy, follow `/vss-search-archive`: set `VSS_REPO_ROOT="${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}"`, validate `services/agent/pyproject.toml`, run `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss search run --help`, and record the deployment with `vss configure --base-url http://localhost:7777`. Do not ingest sample media in this step.
checks: `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/health` returns exit 0 (Agent REST API responsive)
`curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8018/v1/models` returns exit 0 (search RT-VLM proxy responsive)
The deployed search configuration uses `VLM_MODEL_TYPE=rtvi`, `VLM_NAME_SLUG=none`, `VLM_MODE=remote`, `RTVI_VLM_MODEL_TO_USE=openai-compat`, and `RTVI_VLM_MODEL_PATH=none`

The project-local CLI is usable from the validated checkout: `cd "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}" && uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/video-search-and-summarization}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss search run --help` returns exit 0. The `--extra cli` flag is required; a globally installed `vss` is not an acceptable substitute
The agent recorded the deployment against the ingress origin `http://localhost:7777` rather than a container port, and did not ingest sample media during this deployment step
